nodes.summary: Let $I$ be a finite set, let $P$ be a doubly stochastic real $I \times I$ matrix (its entries are nonnegative and each of its rows and columns sums to $1$), and let $c_{ij} \in \mathbb{R}$ for $i, j \in I$. Then there is a permutation $\sigma$ of $I$ with $\sum_i c_{i \sigma(i)} \le \sum_i \sum_j c_{ij} P_{ij}$. That is, the linear functional $M \mapsto \sum_{i, j} c_{ij} M_{ij}$ takes a value at some permutation…
nodes.title: Linear functionals on doubly stochastic matrices are bounded below at a permutation

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be real symmetric matrices with rows and columns indexed by a finite set $I$, and let $(\alpha_i)_{i \in I}$ and $(\beta_i)_{i \in I}$ be their eigenvalues, listed with multiplicity. Then there is a permutation $\sigma$ of $I$ with $\sum_i \alpha_i \beta_{\sigma(i)} \le \operatorname{tr}(AB)$.
nodes.title: A pairing of eigenvalues bounds the trace of a product from below

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be real symmetric matrices with rows and columns indexed by a finite set $I$, and let $(\alpha_i)_{i \in I}$ and $(\beta_i)_{i \in I}$ be their eigenvalues, listed with multiplicity. Then there is a permutation $\sigma$ of $I$ with $\operatorname{tr}(AB) \le \sum_i \alpha_i \beta_{\sigma(i)}$.
nodes.title: A pairing of eigenvalues bounds the trace of a product from above

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be a real symmetric matrix with rows and columns indexed by a finite set $I$, and let $(v_j)_{j \in I}$ be the orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^I$ of eigenvectors of $B$ chosen by the spectral theorem, with $B v_j = \beta_j v_j$. Then for every $x \in \mathbb{R}^I$, $\langle x, Bx \rangle = \sum_j \beta_j \langle v_j, x \rangle^2$.
nodes.title: The quadratic form of a symmetric matrix in an orthonormal eigenbasis

nodes.summary: Let $I$ be a finite set and let $(u_i)_{i \in I}$ and $(v_j)_{j \in I}$ be orthonormal bases of $\mathbb{R}^I$ with its standard inner product. Then the $I \times I$ matrix with entries $P_{ij} = \langle v_j, u_i \rangle^2$ is doubly stochastic: its entries are nonnegative and each of its rows and columns sums to $1$.
nodes.title: The overlap matrix of two orthonormal bases is doubly stochastic

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be real symmetric matrices with rows and columns indexed by a finite set $I$. Let $(u_i)_{i \in I}$ and $(v_j)_{j \in I}$ be the orthonormal bases of $\mathbb{R}^I$ of eigenvectors of $A$ and $B$ chosen by the spectral theorem, with $A u_i = \alpha_i u_i$ and $B v_j = \beta_j v_j$. Then $\operatorname{tr}(AB) = \sum_i \sum_j \alpha_i \beta_j \langle v_j, u_i \rangle^2$.
nodes.title: The trace of a product of symmetric matrices in their eigenbases
